mapper.select: SELECT message_room_id, trade_post_id, buyer_user_id, status, created_at, last_message_at FROM trade_message_room WHERE trade_post_id = #{tradePostId} AND buyer_user_id = #{buyerUserId} LIMIT 1
SELECT message_room_id, trade_post_id, buyer_user_id, status, created_at, last_message_at FROM trade_message_room WHERE message_room_id = #{messageRoomId} LIMIT 1
SELECT message_id, message_room_id, sender_user_id, message_text, created_at, read_at FROM trade_message WHERE message_room_id = #{messageRoomId} ORDER BY message_id ASC

SELECT TMR.message_room_id, TMR.trade_post_id, TP.title AS trade_post_title, CASE WHEN TMR.buyer_user_id = #{userId} THEN TP.seller_user_id ELSE TMR.buyer_user_id END AS opponent_user_id, CASE WHEN TMR.buyer_user_id = #{userId} THEN SU.name ELSE BU.name END AS opponent_name, LM.message_text AS last_message_text, TMR.last_message_at, COALESCE(TM.unread_count, 0) AS unread_count FROM trade_message_room TMR INNER JOIN trade_post TP ON TMR.trade_post_id = TP.trade_post_id INNER JOIN users SU ON TP.seller_user_id = SU.user_id INNER JOIN users BU ON TMR.buyer_user_id = BU.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT message_room_id, MAX(message_id) AS last_message_id, SUM( CASE WHEN sender_user_id != #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS unread_count FROM trade_message GROUP BY message_room_id ) TM ON TMR.message_room_id = TM.message_room_id LEFT JOIN trade_message LM ON TM.last_message_id = LM.message_id WHERE TMR.buyer_user_id = #{userId} OR TP.seller_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY COALESCE(TMR.last_message_at, TMR.created_at) DESC
